source: Binance TR public API historical OHLCV

label.entry_time_definition: M1 candle close used as forward-label decision proxy
label.onset_definition: lowest low in the preceding horizon window before threshold crossing

limitations: Events are forward labels for research, not executable signals.
Historical spread, orderbook, liquidity and slippage are unavailable.
The last 15 minutes are excluded from candidate decisions because the full forward horizon is required.
